comment: Gem sockets on any gear (gem wave G4; docs/kiln/services/gems-sockets.md). createPide (items/CreatePide, items.json) gives an empty WeaponGemSlot only when ItemInfo.category == Weapons and either the BalancingRegistry chance roll wins or ItemInfo.gemSlotOverride.isSet: `cmp byte [rdi+0x798], r12b; jne add; test r15b, r15b; je skip` (server 26430253 0x1b1da8). items/item.gem_override is that offset; kiln.items reads it in its createPide hook to honour gemSlotOverride on gear of every category. The rest of the feature is items.pide_options' own symbols and constants (items.json).
